# Penetration Testing Accreditation

Cybranytech FZ-LLC holds a current penetration-testing accreditation issued by
the Regional Assurance Council under scheme reference RAC-PT-2024-0817.

Accreditation holder: Cybranytech FZ-LLC, Dubai Internet City, United Arab Emirates.
Scheme: Penetration Testing Services (Infrastructure, Web Application, API).
Issued: 28 April 2024.
Valid until: 27 April 2027.
Status: Active. Surveillance audit completed 14 March 2026 with no findings.

The accreditation covers the delivery of penetration-testing engagements by
qualified testers against the Council's published testing standard, and
authorises Cybranytech to issue assured test reports under scheme reference
RAC-PT-2024-0817.
